description: This file defines a cross-platform interface for time-related functions and data structures, wrapping the POSIX 'timespec' and providing functions for getting the current time, computing elapsed time, comparing times, converting to string, and converting to 'timespec'.

methods.name: rtTime_Now
methods.description: Retrieve the current system time as 'rtTime_t'.

methods.name: rtTime_Later
methods.description: Calculate a future time 'ms' milliseconds from a given 'from' time, or now if 'from' is NULL.

methods.name: rtTime_Elapsed
methods.description: Compute the elapsed milliseconds between 'start' and 'end' times.

methods.name: rtTime_ToString
methods.description: Convert an 'rtTime_t' to a human-readable string in HH:MM:SS.mmm format.
